$comment: Logical schema; signaling is encrypted inside OM control channel.

CallSession.participants: authenticated, sorted set of joined DeviceIdentity endpoints inside the E2EE context; bound into the group-call key exporter context and changed (with rekey) on every join or leave (ADR-0128 rule 14)
CallSession.key_derivation: 1:1: session exporter bound to CallID and participants. Group: MLS exporter over (CallID, epoch, sorted participant set); any Room endpoint holding the epoch can compute it, so key isolation from non-joined members is open (A-035).
CallSession.key_capable_non_participants: full-room ServicePrincipals and BridgePrincipals that could derive call keys; the call UI shows them

AdmissionRule: A call.offer from a principal without an accepted relationship is dropped (at most a MessageRequest-class missed-call notice: no ringing, ICE or TURN). Starting a group call that rings the Room needs room.start_call. Toward any peer that is not an accepted contact, Room co-members included, only relay candidates are used.
